info.title: Zeiterfassung API
info.description: Native api.php contract based on main fd166a2d3e78be9d40a873f93ad0c2c398a6561f (2026-10-28), with controlled JSON errors and an entrypoint-local catchable-Throwable boundary; not a full runtime acceptance. Server-time attendance and actual breaks; own-account reads only. Existing handlers and native abort_request failures, including controlled bootstrap refusals, use {success:false,message} with the original HTTP status. Catchable unexpected bootstrap/dispatch failures now return JSON 500 with a fixed Internal server error message; uncatchable failures remain outside the guarantee. No global handler. terminal_api.php has a separate local bootstrap/Throwable JSON503 boundary documented in docs/TERMINAL.md; its signed raw-body protocol is unchanged. See docs/API-CONTRACT.md for scope and remaining limits. No geolocation webhook is implemented. Inactive framework candidates now match controlled-error JSON envelopes via their central response formatter, preserving statuses and messages without changing authentication acceptance or activating published endpoints; their full HTTP/client acceptance remains open. The #35 accepted end with an all-day absence overlap remains HTTP 200/success true and can add overlap_record_ids and overlap_warning to the stored receipt/message; this is not a 409 refusal. Controlled statuses, CORS/OPTIONS, Retry-After, authentication and write semantics remain unchanged; invalid UTF-8 in raw read successes now fails as JSON500, not empty200. No full HTTP/client acceptance or commit/rollback guarantee is claimed.

400.description: Missing/non-string username or password: controlled JSON 400.

401.description: Invalid credentials: JSON 401; protected-route bearer refusals also use the same envelope.

429.description: Shared login budget exceeded: controlled JSON 429, preserving Retry-After: 600.

example.message: Too many login attempts. Try again later.

post.description: Local-account credential login only; no LDAP login here. Token lasts one hour, is invalidated by password change/account deletion. Catchable unexpected pre-handler/malformed-input failures use the entrypoint JSON500 fallback, not a new validation400; uncatchable failures remain outside the guarantee.

location.description: Start only. Canonical stored code; present null or translated labels are refused.

note.description: Start only. At most 1000 UTF-8 bytes; no ASCII U+0000-U+001F/U+007F, no exact reserved absence labels Urlaub/Krankheit/Feiertag. No trimming, normalization or truncation. Omission means empty; present null is refused.

200.description: Confirmed server-time start; top-level record_id, no data.id.

400.description: Invalid JSON or decoded body that is neither array nor object: controlled JSON 400. Arrays, including [], pass the legacy array check. Invalid event ID is also JSON 400. Other malformed types are not universally normalized.

409.description: Historical fields refused and attendance state/overlap conflicts: JSON 409 with the existing message.

value.message: Use a correction request for historical entries.

post.description: Compatibility alias for attendance/start, not a historical entry writer. Send an object and stable event_id for safe retries. If event_id is absent/null, a random ID is generated, so retry cannot be correlated. Non-empty endzeit or pause triggers text-409; client startzeit and legacy beschreibung/standort are not used. Actual start uses server time; omitted metadata defaults to an empty note and office. Optional start-only location/note are validated and stored per docs/CH45-START-METADATA.md. Nondefault metadata extends the event hash using start-metadata-v1 and requires exact same metadata on replay; defaults preserve the original hash/receipt. Non-start metadata is JSON400.

post.summary: End the current own work session using server time

id.description: Recommended matching record ID, including exact string from status. Native legacy PHP integer coercion remains unchanged; this schema is not a new strict alias validator.

200.description: Confirmed end; affected record_id stays positive even though state is absent. An accepted end with all-day absence overlap is also HTTP 200/success true; optional overlap fields/message carry a warning, not a 409 error.

accepted_end_overlap.summary: Saved end with historical absence warning, not a failed transition

value.message: Buchung bestätigt. Arbeitsende gespeichert. Arbeitszeit überschneidet sich mit einer ganztägigen Abwesenheit. Betroffene Summen sind bis zur manuellen Klärung nicht abschließend. Bitte Korrekturanträge prüfen.
value.overlap_warning: Arbeitsende gespeichert. Arbeitszeit überschneidet sich mit einer ganztägigen Abwesenheit. Betroffene Summen sind bis zur manuellen Klärung nicht abschließend. Bitte Korrekturanträge prüfen.

post.description: Compatibility alias for attendance/end. Request id must match the current record; it is integer-coerced by the legacy adapter (missing/null becomes 0 and conflicts). Response uses top-level record_id, not id. Omitted/null event_id generates a random ID: supply a stable ID for retries. Only boolean true confirms an active pause; client timestamps are ignored. Start-only location/note are refused with JSON400, not used to update metadata.

get.description: Own account only, even for an administrator. No user/team selector. Normally one item, never a directory of multiple people.

get.summary: Get only the authenticated account's correction request statuses
get.description: Read-only own-account snapshot, including for admin/supervisor tokens. No reason, proposed/original time, reviewer identity, mutation, notification/delivery receipt or review permission. IDs and epoch seconds are exact decimal strings. Offset pages can shift with new requests. Optional request_id narrows the same own-account snapshot to one exact request; foreign/nonexistent IDs both return an empty matching set. Pagination and status remain conjunctive filters; no notification or write retry is triggered. Native retains its existing bearer JWT/password-version guard. Laravel retains its separate API admission/generation/operating policy and raw HTTP method/URL rules; those gates are not added to Native. Optional record_id filters the stored record reference of the same own requests; it does not query or attest existence/ownership of that referenced booking. All selectors are conjunctive and counts precede pagination. Requests without a stored record reference do not match this filter.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: Optional exact positive ASCII decimal string 1..9223372036854775807, no leading zero, sign, whitespace or exponent. Narrows only the authenticated account; never selects an owner. For a known-request poll omit offset and use limit at least 1.

parameters.name: record_id
parameters.description: Optional exact positive stored record reference (1..9223372036854775807), without leading zeros, signs, whitespace or exponent. Same own-request scope; conjunctive with status/request_id/pagination. Does not check booking existence or ownership.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: ASCII decimal integer; default 100, range 0..1000. Zero returns an empty page.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: ASCII decimal integer 0..2147483647; omission skips zero with null metadata.

200.description: Own stored statuses and matching count in the same authenticated read snapshot.

request_id.description: Present only when request_id was explicitly supplied; echoes the validated selector, not proof of ownership, existence or delivery.

record_id.description: Present only when record_id was explicitly supplied; echoes the validated stored-reference selector, not proof of booking ownership/existence, review permission or delivery.

400.description: Invalid raw query; only status, limit and offset are accepted. No subject selector.

503.description: Read unavailable or malformed source status: fixed Correction status unavailable. No exception details or partial rows. Controlled bootstrap/profile errors retain their existing envelope.

get.summary: Get filtered time entries for the authenticated user

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Inclusive Europe/Berlin reporting start-day lower bound via chrono_api_booking_day(startzeit); YYYY-MM-DD syntax only. Offset-free stored values are interpreted in Berlin; offset/Z values are converted to Berlin. Unreadable starts are excluded only when date filtering is used.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Inclusive Europe/Berlin reporting start-day upper bound via chrono_api_booking_day(startzeit); no calendar or start<=end validation. Overnight entries belong to their Berlin start day; count and page use the same predicate.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Single ASCII decimal-digit integer 0..1000; leading zeros allowed. Omitted defaults to 100, including offset-only queries; 0 returns an empty page. Invalid scalar/array, signed, decimal, exponential, whitespace or out-of-range input returns JSON 400 before SQL. Deliberate change: omission is no longer unlimited.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Single ASCII decimal-digit integer 0..2147483647; leading zeros allowed. Omitted skips zero and meta.offset remains null. Invalid scalar/array or out-of-range input returns JSON 400 before SQL. Offset-only uses the default limit 100, not unlimited LIMIT -1.

200.description: Own entries with raw legacy fields and pagination metadata.

400.description: Invalid pagination type/syntax/range, or invalid scalar date syntax (not a full calendar-validation guarantee). Pagination rejection is JSON 400 before SQL; bootstrap and authentication run earlier.

get.description: Own raw reporting rows ordered before paging by chrono_report_start_epoch(startzeit) DESC, id DESC (instant order, descending ID tie-break; unreadable starts remain SQL NULL last); no user_id selector, overlap-window selection or normalization. Inclusive date bounds use the Europe/Berlin reporting start day via chrono_api_booking_day(startzeit), shared with report_day; no day splitting. Empty/unreadable starts are excluded under date filters, not repaired. Syntax-only query dates. Strict nonnegative integer pagination: limit defaults to 100, maximum 1000, 0 returns no rows; offset defaults to zero, maximum 2147483647. meta.limit is the effective integer limit; omitted meta.offset stays null. Deliberate compatibility change: omitted limit and offset-only no longer return unlimited rows. Iterate pages using explicit limit/offset; see docs/API-CONTRACT.md.

delete.summary: Disabled: use an approved cancellation request

409.description: Cancellation requires an approved correction request: controlled JSON 409; no deletion or record lookup.

example.message: Use an approved correction request to cancel a record.

delete.description: Native numeric-ID route is an authenticated lock, not a deletion endpoint. It always refuses with text-409; no record lookup and no 200/403/404 record-specific outcome. No correction-submission API is implied.

expected_record.description: Optional exact active record ID, canonical positive ASCII decimal <= PHP_INT_MAX. Present invalid values are JSON400. Omission retains legacy null semantics; no new required-field or client upgrade. Already committed identical payloads replay before current-record matching.

location.description: Start only. Canonical stored code; present null or translated labels are refused.

note.description: Start only. At most 1000 UTF-8 bytes; no ASCII U+0000-U+001F/U+007F, no exact reserved absence labels Urlaub/Krankheit/Feiertag. No trimming, normalization or truncation. Omission means empty; present null is refused.

200.description: Confirmed event, or stored idempotent replay. Refresh GET status after an acknowledgement. An accepted end with all-day absence overlap is also HTTP 200/success true; optional overlap fields/message carry a warning, not a 409 error.

accepted_end_overlap.summary: Saved end with historical absence warning, not a failed transition

value.message: Buchung bestätigt. Arbeitsende gespeichert. Arbeitszeit überschneidet sich mit einer ganztägigen Abwesenheit. Betroffene Summen sind bis zur manuellen Klärung nicht abschließend. Bitte Korrekturanträge prüfen.

post.description: Own server-time start/pause/end transition. event_id is required; reuse the identical ID and parsed action/confirmation/expected-record semantics after an unconfirmed response. Same-ID payload conflict is 409; stored replay can be stale. Only boolean true confirms ending an active pause. Optional expected_record is a canonical positive decimal string checked before cast and forwarded to the existing record guard; omission remains null for old clients. This route still ignores id; setendzeit keeps its legacy id alias. New popup pause/resume bodies bind only after exact-string status metadata is available. Request timestamps and user selectors are not authoritative. Optional start-only location/note are validated and stored per docs/CH45-START-METADATA.md. Nondefault metadata extends the event hash using start-metadata-v1 and requires exact same metadata on replay; defaults preserve the original hash/receipt. Non-start metadata is JSON400.

get.description: Read-only own status snapshot with existing bearer validation. No query/body user selector, booking, event_id, time or local_time. absent -> record_id null; working/paused -> positive integer. A legacy open reporting row can return working without a managed session; multiple legacy open rows are not diagnosed by this read. Additive record_id_string duplicates the same current ID exactly as a decimal string or null; older clients may ignore it. It is metadata from the same snapshot, not a receipt or another query. Additive start_metadata_version:1 advertises this source contract; it is not authorization or a receipt. Explicit workflow=1 adds only the already implemented state-level workflow block in the same own read snapshot. Only the exact raw PHP string 1 opts in; malformed present values fail JSON400 after existing bearer validation and before the read transaction. Missing workflow preserves the default response. Hints are state_only, require a later write recheck, are not authorization/receipts, and never replace pending event/payload replay or explicit paused-end confirmation.

200.description: Current own state, not a historical acknowledgement. Only explicit workflow=1 adds state-level action hints; no action is reserved or approved.

workflow_absent.summary: Actual isolated own read with workflow=1: absent

workflow_working.summary: Actual isolated own read with workflow=1: working

workflow_paused.summary: Actual isolated own read with workflow=1: paused

400.description: After existing bearer validation, a present workflow value other than the exact scalar string 1 is refused before reading the status snapshot.

parameters.name: workflow
parameters.description: Existing explicit opt-in only: raw workflow=1. Omit for the unchanged default status. Empty, other or array-shaped values are invalid after the existing bearer guard. No person/record selector is introduced.

get.summary: Read the authenticated account's effective stored work-model version
get.description: Own stored weekly schedule only, even for administrator/supervisor tokens. Optional canonical calendar date, default current server Berlin day. No owner/model selector, reason, author, account metadata, holiday/absence/target/balance calculation, model change, approval or notification. If no stored effective version exists, data is null, not zero or a calculated legacy fallback. Native retains its existing bearer/password-version guard; Laravel retains its separate API admission/generation/operating policy and exact raw method/URL gates.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Canonical YYYY-MM-DD, years0001..9999; omitted means current server Berlin day. No trimming, array, invalid date or unknown query/owner selector.

200.description: At most one own version, selected by valid_from descending then exact ID descending, within one authenticated read snapshot. Null is no stored effective version, never no work/no entitlement.

model_id.description: Exact positive SQLite signed64 decimal string, never a JSON number.

weekday_minutes.description: Stored base minutes Monday through Sunday; no holiday or absence adjustment.

400.description: Invalid raw query/date or wrong existing API endpoint/method combination.

401.description: Existing invalid/missing bearer identity response, not a web-session fallback.

503.description: Fixed Work model unavailable JSON envelope; malformed/unavailable source exposes no partial model or details.

get.summary: Discover the authenticated account's stored work-model versions
get.description: Own bounded stored version list, even for administrator/supervisor tokens. Discover historical and future effective dates without guessing a date. Same exact ID/date/minute projection as GET /work-model. No owner/model/date selector, reason, author, account metadata, target/balance/holiday/absence calculation, write, approval or notification. Pages are separate current snapshots, not an immutable audit/export or completeness attestation. Existing Native/Laravel bearer and separate Laravel admission/generation/raw method/URL gates remain.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Existing bounded API pagination; default 100, maximum 1000, zero returns metadata only.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Existing offset from 0 through 2147483647. Omitted offset is reported as null and skips zero rows.

200.description: Own selected page, ordered by valid_from DESC then exact ID DESC. Each selected row validates as a whole; malformed rows refuse the whole page with 503. Empty is no selected stored rows, not no work/entitlement or a legacy fallback.

model_id.description: Exact positive SQLite signed64 decimal string, never a JSON number.

weekday_minutes.description: Stored base minutes Monday through Sunday; no holiday or absence adjustment.

400.description: Invalid raw query or pagination, including unknown fields or any owner/model/date/role selector. Only limit and offset are accepted.

401.description: Existing invalid/missing bearer identity response, not a web-session fallback.

503.description: Stored page, source or optional reader unavailable; no partial page or exception details.

Error.description: Native API error envelope: controlled abort_request/bootstrap/auth/validation/rate-limit refusals and existing handlers preserve their statuses. The api.php-local catchable-Throwable fallback uses fixed JSON500; read encoding failures also fail500. Message is not a stable machine error code. Uncatchable/server failures are outside this guarantee; terminal_api.php has a separate JSON503 scope in docs/TERMINAL.md, not this API500 contract; no global handler or full HTTP/client acceptance.

record_id.description: Current own open record, otherwise null. Legacy open reporting rows can yield working.

record_id_string.description: Additive exact text of the same record_id, not a replacement numeric field. Null when no current record.

start_metadata_version.description: Additive start-metadata wire contract version, not a write authority.

AttendanceStatus.description: Read-only status: absent has null record_id; working/paused have a positive integer record_id. No event ID or timestamp is returned. The optional additive record_id_string preserves exact record-ID text for updated clients; malformed present metadata must not be repaired through numeric fallback. The optional workflow block is returned only for the exact workflow=1 opt-in; its version-1 values are hints from that same snapshot and not a write capability. Default fields/required list are unchanged.

message.description: Existing acknowledgement text, with pause_warning and/or overlap_warning appended when present. An accepted end-overlap warning remains HTTP 200 and success true, not an error envelope.

local_time.description: Same event in Europe/Berlin with explicit offset.

record_id.description: Confirmed affected record, including after end; not data.id and not null when state is absent.

pause_warning.description: Optional warning after end; a configured minimum pause is not automatically deducted.

overlap_record_ids.description: Optional on an accepted end when its completed work overlaps all-day absence: deduplicated integer IDs of those absence reporting rows, not a new work record/event ID. Absent when no such overlap was found. Stored historical receipt metadata, not a current conflict diagnosis.

overlap_warning.description: Optional end-overlap clarification warning, also appended to message after any pause warning. Work end is saved: HTTP 200, success true, state absent. A stored replay retains this historical warning even after a later correction.

record_id_string.description: Additive exact text of the same record_id, not a replacement numeric field. Affected positive record even after end; projected from the original receipt, never a fresh binding or stored JSON rewrite.

location.description: Start only. Canonical stored code; present null or translated labels are refused.

note.description: Start only. At most 1000 UTF-8 bytes; no ASCII U+0000-U+001F/U+007F, no exact reserved absence labels Urlaub/Krankheit/Feiertag. No trimming, normalization or truncation. Omission means empty; present null is refused.

start_metadata.description: Only new nondefault starts include this exact stored metadata acknowledgement. Old/default/Terminal receipts are not rebuilt or augmented.

AttendanceReceipt.description: Stored acknowledgement of this event. A replay can describe an older state: refresh GET /attendance before another action. Since #35, a saved end overlapping all-day absence can include optional overlap_record_ids/overlap_warning and an extended message, still HTTP 200/success true. Genuine refused transitions remain JSON 409/success false. The optional additive record_id_string preserves exact record-ID text for updated clients; malformed present metadata must not be repaired through numeric fallback.

User.description: Own selected DB fields; no global user list or new role enum.

UsersResponse.description: Normally one own user; SELECT can return an empty array if the account disappears between token validation and the read.

id.description: Legacy reporting-row ID (different field name from attendance receipt record_id).

startzeit.description: Stored timestamp, not normalized by the read endpoint; legacy strings may lack an offset.

pause.description: Stored pause minutes; not recalculated by this endpoint.

TimeEntry.description: Raw own SELECT * reporting projection; legacy nullable fields and additional DB columns are not removed. Numeric examples assume normal SQLite/PDO serialization; values are not explicitly cast by the reader.

total.description: Count of own date-filtered rows before pagination; PDO value is not explicitly cast.

filtered.description: Rows returned on this page, not total matching rows.

limit.description: Effective limit, including default 100 when omitted; no longer null.

offset.description: Validated explicit offset; null when omitted (effective zero).

version.description: Observed projection version; do not infer support merely from host or application version.

allowed_actions.description: State-only hints: absent -> start; working -> pause_start/end; paused -> pause_end/end. Current auth, expected record, business conflicts and commit are rechecked by the unchanged writer.

expected_record.description: Exact same record_id_string from this snapshot, or null when absent. Use this decimal text rather than a rounded JavaScript numeric ID. This hint is not a receipt, reservation or write authority.

confirmation_required_actions.description: end only while paused; otherwise empty. A client must obtain explicit human confirmation before sending confirm_end_pause:true; this read does not grant that confirmation.

AttendanceWorkflow.description: Already implemented explicit Native own-read metadata. No user/record selector, approval, notification or writer behavior is added by this schema. Do not create a new event ID or discard pending payloads because of this read.

BearerUnauthorized.description: Native bearer validation failure: controlled JSON 401, preserving the existing message and validation conditions.

BootstrapUnavailable.description: Controlled shared bootstrap/storage/database refusal: native JSON 503 before the handler. Other catchable unexpected failures use the entrypoint JSON500 fallback; uncatchable failures are not guaranteed.

AttendanceUnavailable.description: JSON 503 from the attendance handler or a controlled earlier bootstrap refusal. Mutation outcome may be unconfirmed: retry the same event ID and content. Catchable unexpected failures outside the attendance handler use JSON500; uncatchable failures remain outside the guarantee.

value.message: Buchung nicht bestätigt. Verbindung prüfen und denselben Vorgang erneut versuchen.

AttendanceBadRequest.description: Invalid event ID or action (JSON). Malformed types are not universally normalized to 400.

AttendanceConflict.description: Genuinely refused transition: start/state conflict, event ID reused with different content, expected record mismatch or missing active-pause confirmation (JSON 409, success false). Since #35 a saved end overlapping all-day absence instead succeeds with HTTP 200 and optional receipt warnings; it is not this response.

example.message: Aktive Pause und Arbeitszeit gemeinsam beenden? Bitte bestätigen.

ReadFailure.description: Existing read Exception catch: JSON500 Internal server error, now also for unencodable raw UTF-8 success data; no empty HTTP200. Other catchable unexpected failures use the same envelope via the entrypoint boundary.

UnexpectedFailure.description: Entrypoint-local catchable unexpected bootstrap/dispatch Throwable: JSON500, fixed message, no raw diagnostics. No commit/rollback guarantee or automatic retry. Controlled statuses including attendance503 are unchanged; uncatchable/server failures are not covered.

x-router-behavior.OPTIONS: 200, empty body, any path before authentication/bootstrap; existing CORS permits GET, POST, OPTIONS, DELETE.
x-router-behavior.unsupported-method: Other methods, including HEAD: 405 application/json {success:false,message:"Method Not Allowed"}, after bootstrap.
x-router-behavior.unhandled-failures: Within this native API contract, after unchanged CORS/OPTIONS, api.php owns a local buffer and try/catch(Throwable). Catchable unexpected bootstrap/dispatch failures discard only owned buffered bytes and terminate JSON500 {success:false,message:"Internal server error"}, without raw/newly logged diagnostics. Existing abort/attendance exits and statuses remain unchanged. No global exception/shutdown/warning handler, new retry or rollback guarantee. Entry compile failures, memory exhaustion, termination/server/proxy responses and bytes outside the owned boundary are not guaranteed. terminal_api.php is excluded from this API500 contract and has its own local JSON503 boundary; see docs/TERMINAL.md. Its signed protocol is unchanged. Full HTTP/header/client acceptance remains open.
x-router-behavior.controlled-errors: Native api.php and the separate terminal_api.php entrypoint opt in with the strict server-owned CHRONO_API_JSON_ERRORS=true before config/security bootstrap; Accept, headers, query/body and script name cannot select this mode. abort_request retains the HTTP status, uses application/json; charset=UTF-8 and {success:false,message}, substituting invalid message UTF-8 bytes with U+FFFD. Existing Retry-After: 600 on login-budget 429 and all CORS/OPTIONS behavior remain unchanged. Ordinary web abort_request output stays text/plain with original message bytes. Existing inactive Laravel behavior is unchanged by this native-only boundary.
